title: Multidimensional Dickman distribution and operator selfdecomposability
summary: The one-dimensional Dickman distribution arises in various stochastic models across number theory, combinatorics, physics, and biology. Recently, a definition of the multidimensional Dickman distribution has appeared in the literature, together with its application to approximating the small jumps of multidimensional Lévy processes.
